title: Tools
description: Explore a variety of practical tools we offer, including subtitle processing, music editing, and file renaming, to help you complete tasks efficiently.

sub_desc.subtitle_tools: AI translation, format conversion, and other subtitle processing features.
sub_desc.music_tools: Convert paid music to FLAC/MP3 format.
sub_desc.audio_tools: ASR, TTS, realtime captions, and duplex voice workspace.

field_desc.subtitle_translator: Translate subtitle files with AI models
field_desc.subtitle_language_extractor: Extract a specific language from bilingual subtitles
field_desc.local_subtitle_transcriber: Batch transcribe audio or video into SRT / LRC subtitles with an on-device model
field_desc.name_translator: Batch translate file and folder names with a safe preview before renaming
field_desc.text_translator: Translate long TXT / Markdown files in a resumable workspace with model execution
field_desc.audio_transcriber: Transcribe local audio files with the global ASR configuration
field_desc.speech_synthesizer: Generate and play speech audio with the global TTS configuration
field_desc.realtime_captions: Create realtime or near-realtime captions from microphone input
field_desc.realtime_voice: Start a duplex voice session through Realtime/WebRTC
field_desc.subtitle_studio: Transcribe, translate and batch export bilingual subtitles
